subject: polity
title: Indian Prime Ministers (1947-Present)
description: Complete list of all 18 Prime Ministers with their tenures and key contributions

content.overview: India has had 18 Prime Ministers since independence in 1947. Here is the complete list with tenures and key facts.
keyPoints: 1. Jawaharlal Nehru (1947-1964): First PM, 17 years, non-alignment, industrialization
2. Gulzarilal Nanda (Acting) (1964): 13 days, after Nehru's death
3. Lal Bahadur Shastri (1964-1966): 'Jai Jawan Jai Kisan', 1965 war, Tashkent Agreement
4. Gulzarilal Nanda (Acting) (1966): 13 days, after Shastri's death
5. Indira Gandhi (1966-1977): First woman PM, 1971 war, Green Revolution, Emergency
6. Morarji Desai (1977-1979): First non-Congress PM, Janata Party
7. Charan Singh (1979-1980): 23 days, shortest full term
8. Indira Gandhi (1980-1984): Returned to power, Operation Blue Star, assassinated
9. Rajiv Gandhi (1984-1989): Youngest PM (40), technology modernization, Bofors scandal
10. V. P. Singh (1989-1990): Mandal Commission implementation, Janata Dal
11. Chandra Shekhar (1990-1991): 7 months, Samajwadi Janata Party
12. P. V. Narasimha Rao (1991-1996): Economic liberalization, 1991 reforms
13. Atal Bihari Vajpayee (1996): 13 days, first BJP PM
14. H. D. Deve Gowda (1996-1997): 10 months, Janata Dal
15. I. K. Gujral (1997-1998): 11 months, Janata Dal
16. Atal Bihari Vajpayee (1998-2004): Kargil War, NDA government, Golden Quadrilateral
17. Manmohan Singh (2004-2014): 10 years, economic reforms, nuclear deal
18. Narendra Modi (2014-Present): Longest-serving non-Congress PM, GST, Article 370

mnemonics.trick: N-N-S-N-G-D-S-C-G-V-S-G-R-V-M-M = Nehru, Nanda, Shastri, Nanda, Gandhi, Desai, Singh, Gandhi, Gandhi, Singh, Shekhar, Rao, Vajpayee, Gowda, Gujral, Vajpayee, Singh, Modi
mnemonics.explanation: Remember the order: Nehru, Nanda, Shastri, Nanda, Indira, Desai, Charan, Indira, Rajiv, VP Singh, Shekhar, Rao, Vajpayee, Gowda, Gujral, Vajpayee, Manmohan, Modi

quiz.question: Who was the first Prime Minister of India?
quiz.explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru was the first Prime Minister of India (1947-1964)

quiz.question: Who was the first woman Prime Minister of India?
quiz.explanation: Indira Gandhi was the first woman Prime Minister of India

quiz.question: Who was the youngest Prime Minister of India?
quiz.explanation: Rajiv Gandhi became PM at age 40 in 1984

timeline.event: Indira Gandhi became first woman PM
